chosen_market_source.type: public on-chain Uniswap V3 Swap event history on Arbitrum One

capability_metadata.rationale: The same immutable Uniswap V3 pool exists from 2024-07-30 and has an on-chain Swap observation on 2025-10-26, a 453-day pre-2026 span. Address-scoped Arbitrum log history is the market-data source; future outcome extraction can reconstruct pool price from Swap state without a proprietary historical API.

provenance.metadata_only: 2024-07-30 launch; Dex-first on Uniswap v3, Arbitrum, live
LAVA/WETH pool address and 2024-07-30 creation date
2025-10-26 UTC transaction contains Swap event emitted by the same pool address
Swap event schema exposes amount0, amount1 and sqrtPriceX96; numerical values were not stored or used in this source gate
